instruction.german: What are the main ideas of the text?

configs.question: Choose the best description: A, B or C.
configs.correctAnswer: B Levi’s jeans have a 175-year history. They are very strong and also look great. They are an important part of many different fashion styles.

additionalAnswers.answer: A Levi Strauss came from Germany. He started a business in the USA with his brothers. They made clothes.
B Levi’s jeans have a 175-year history. They are very strong and also look great. They are an important part of many different fashion styles.
C One hundred years ago, jeans were work clothes. Today, they are popular with teenagers. People all over the world wear jeans.
